nit: please consider using `getAssociatedSubTree` instead of the
two-step `getAssociationEndPoints` + `getDbusObject`. The single call returns (path, serviceMap) in one mapper round-trip, and removes the need for the intermediate afterGetProcessorFirmwareVersionService callback.
```
    dbus::utility::getAssociatedSubTree(
        sdbusplus::object_path(processorPath) / "ran_on",
        sdbusplus::object_path("/xyz/openbmc_project/software"), 0,
        softwareIfaces,
        std::bind_front(afterGetProcessorFirmwareVersionSubTree, asyncResp));
```

Thanks for the catching though!

In here EBADR is ignored, that's the usual "optional data not present"
case. But io_error feels broader to me. It can also show up for actual
method-call failures or service issues, not just missing properties. Lumping
them together means a real D-Bus failure would look identical to "feature not
supported," which could make this painful to debug later???

Oh yeah that sounds reasonable that the error catched is too broad here.
I have removed the if condition to catch only `EBADR` error now.
